repaired_lifecycle.supports: Production removal/restoration hooks execute native destruction, restoration, command failure, replacement and failed/nested replacement. Captured O-ZY3A route is cleared without changing motion/fuel; weak references release and unchanged restoration allocates zero.

target_kind.description: Identity-bearing target versus an independent point or stellar object.

lifetime.description: Hidden is not destroyed; replacement preserves logical identity.

shared.description: Observer uses the exact destination ShipSitu rather than an owned waypoint.

ports.description: Nonstation docking-port availability is separate from target lifetime.

goal.description: Destination assigned versus cleared; coordinate destinations need not have a registry ID.

collision.description: Native collision prediction may divert anchored flight into the manual child.
